_comment: The styles an export adds to the ones chosen (#358). The Export & Import tab says before the export which styles will be added (addedParents() in assets/js/admin-export.js, Based On parents only); the server adds them and says so after it (Typost_PS_Transfer::export(): Based On parents, GREP targets and nested rule targets, breadth first). Read by assets/js/__tests__/admin-export-added-styles.test.js (client: [added name, because]) and tests/Unit/ParagraphStylesExportAddedStylesTest.php (server: notes). A label that starts with differs: is a case where the two lists do not match today.

cases.label: a child adds its parent
server: “Body” was added because “Body First” is based on it.

cases.label: a chain adds every level
server: “B” was added because “C” is based on it.
“A” was added because “B” is based on it.

cases.label: a parent two children share is added once
server: “Base” was added because “X” is based on it.

cases.label: a parent that is chosen too is not added
differs: the order (the client walks each chain to its top, the server goes breadth first)
server: “P1” was added because “C1” is based on it.
“P2” was added because “C2” is based on it.
“Grand” was added because “P1” is based on it.

cases.label: differs: a GREP rule target (only the server adds it)
server: “Figures” was added because a GREP rule of “Body” applies it.

cases.label: differs: a nested rule target (only the server adds it)
server: “Lead” was added because a nested rule of “Body” applies it.

cases.label: differs: the parent of a GREP rule target (only the server adds it)
server: “Figures” was added because a GREP rule of “Body” applies it.
“Numbers” was added because “Figures” is based on it.
